name: The Magical Land of Canada
source:
You've heard the stories, you know the legends but Canada is actually real.

In the second chapter of Alter Historia we follow Georgia (George Washington) and Teddy (Theodore Roosevelt) as they make their way to the Summit. On the way they will face several challenges, one of which includes their friend Bonny (Napoleon Bonaparte).

They'll also meet new and exciting villains and allies like Leo Spatula (Cleopatra), Hairheart (Amelia Earhart) and the Elder Moose.

Will they be able to make the Summit in time? Find out now in Alter Historia: The Magical Land of Canada - a powerful and true story of the indomitable spirit.

It's important that Canada and it's people were portrayed accurately in this game so a real Canadian was asked to make sure everything is fact checked. (Yes you read that right, an actual Canadian). So any naysay will not be tolerated.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2326460/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
那些故事，你听过；那些传说，你也知道。但加拿大，居然真的存在。

《Alter Historia》的第二章将跟随Georgia（乔治·华盛顿）与Teddy（西奥多·罗斯福），踏上前往峰会的旅程。途中，她们将面临各种挑战，其中之一就来自朋友Bonny（拿破仑·波拿巴）。

她们还会遇到新奇有趣的反派与盟友，例如Leo Spatula（克娄巴特拉）、Hairheart（阿梅莉亚·埃尔哈特），以及麋鹿长老。

她们能及时赶上峰会吗？现在就来《Alter Historia: The Magical Land of Canada》中寻找答案吧——这是一则关于不屈精神、震撼人心的真实故事。

准确描绘加拿大及其人民，对这款游戏而言至关重要，所以我们特意找来一位真正的加拿大人，核查所有事实。（没错，你没看错，一位货真价实的加拿大人。）因此，任何质疑都不予接受。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2326460/]Steam[/url]]
